jobs.title: Internship in the Office of the Human Rights Ambassador, Geneva (CHEG26-012232)
jobs.company: UK Mission to the United Nations
jobs.description: Important: Please note that we only accept applications submitted through our FCDO CBS Vacancies page. You can access it via the link below https://fco.tal.net/vx/appcentre-ext/brand-2/spa-1/candidate/so/pm/4/pl/1/opp/27229-Internship-in-the-Office-of-the-Human-Rights-Ambassador-Geneva-CHEG26-012232/en-GB Internship in the Office of the Human Rights Ambassador, Geneva (CHEG26-012232) Who are we? The UK Mission in Geneva represents the interests and policies of the UK at many international organisations in Geneva and is recruiting a highly motivated and skilled intern to support the work of the Office of the Global Ambassador for Human Rights and Deputy Permanent Representative to the United Nations in Geneva. The UK Mission in Geneva prioritises dignity and respect at work. We value respect, inclusiveness, empowerment, teamwork and kindness. These qualities will be tested through the recruitment process. Reporting to and working closely with the Ambassador's Personal Assistant, the selected intern will assist with a range of administrative, coordination and representational tasks in support of the Ambassador's programme of work on human rights, humanitarian and migration issues in Geneva and around the world. Are you prepared to play a key role in supporting the Ambassador’s work in fields including human rights, migration, labour rights and international law? Can you bring initiative and creativity to a role that blends office management, communications, organisation of events, visits and logistics? Roles and responsibilities Office Management: Support diary management and daily logistics for the Ambassador, including coordination with diverse stakeholders and communities including governments, NGOs, international organisations, academia and the private sector, organisation of travel, and managing logistical arrangements for meetings and events. Play a lead role in the management of internal databases, file management and updating of planning and briefing documents. Communications: Support the planning and implementation of the Ambassador’s public communications strategy, including working with the UKMIS Communications Team to create impactful content for diverse media and digital channels, including creating and editing videos, drafting social media posts and writing scripts, news articles and Op Eds. Proactively identify opportunities to enhance the implementation of the Ambassador’s communication strategy to reach new stakeholders and communities. Events planning: As part of a wider team, support the organisation of UKMIS events and visits to advance UK priorities. This will include coordination of logistics, protocol, and communication with internal and external partners. Support the organisation of country visits as part of the Ambassador’s global roving role as the UK’s Human Rights Ambassador. Policy: Support humanitarian, migration, political, human rights, labour and international law policy teams on coordination and organisational tasks including in the context of UN institutions and bodies. Essential qualifications, skills and experience Fluency in both oral and written English (minimum of C1 level for CEFR framework*). Excellent communication skills and confidence working with social medial platforms. Interest in creating visual and multimedia content (e.g. working with Canva or similar video production and editing tools). Strong organisational and administrative skills with exceptional attention to detail. Strong interest in multilateralism and international affairs. Good interpersonal skills, able to work with peers and seniors. Highly motivated, flexible and positive team player, who enjoys collaboration and brings initiative and curiosity to work. Willingness to undergo a mandatory security check. Desirable qualifications, skills and experience Previous experience in office management and/or event management. Some previous exposure to a government, diplomatic, international organisation, NGO or UN work environment could be advantageous. Undergraduate Degree or equivalent level studies (including level 5 or 6 course or advanced studies) in fields including international relations, political science, communications, diplomacy or other related areas. Candidates who have not been through Further Education, who can demonstrate the above essential criteria, are strongly encouraged to apply. French language would be a plus. Required behaviours Communicating and Influencing, Delivering at Pace, Managing a Quality Service, Working Together Application deadline 1 September 2026 Grade Internship Type of Position Full-time, Intern, Fixed Term Working hours per week 40 Duration of Post 11 months Region Europe, Eastern Europe & Central Asia Country/Territory Switzerland Location (City) UK Mission to the Office of the United Nations, Geneva Type of Post UK Delegation Number of vacancies 1 Salary Currency CHF monthly Stipend / Allowance 1,450 Start Date 2 November 2026 Other benefits and conditions of employment The UK Mission will offer the intern a monthly training allowance of 1,450 CHF. Please note that interns will need to arrange and pay for their own travel and accommodation, as well as any other living costs. Interns at UKMis will be required to register with the tax office and declare their allowance but only income over 29,400 CHF will be subject to income tax. This internship will be for a period of 11 months All applicants should have permission to live and work in Switzerland. Applicants that have the right to live and work in Geneva and don’t require a visa sponsorship are: Nationals from United Kingdom, European Union and EFTA, along with Nationals of: Brunei Darussalam, Japan, Malaysia, New Zealand, Principality of Andorra, Principality of Monaco, San Marino, Singapore and Vatican – these applicants are eligible to live and work in Switzerland as long as holding a full passport valid for at least 12 months. Where applicable, we encourage successful applicants (if from Europe or the UK) to obtain an Insurance Card (EHIC or GHIC) prior to entering Switzerland. The Mission offers a contribution to the payment of travel insurance for the duration of internship, in place of Private Swiss Health Insurance that includes health & accident cover for all interns. The final appointment and commencement of internship will be dependent upon successful security clearance. Learning & Development: The UK Mission Geneva attaches great importance to the learning and development of its staff, with both formal and informal training and development opportunities available for all employees, in line with a personalised development plan. This learning and development offer is facilitated by the Mission’s L&D Committee, and supported by the L&D Champion. A supervisor will guide the intern and provide on-the-job training and evaluation. There is plenty of learning and development available in this role, with a generous annual allowance to invest in L&D. The calibre of colleagues and breadth of the mission means there is room for personal growth. You will also have the opportunity to understand and contribute to the corporate life of a busy diplomatic mission. Additional information Please note that the deadline for applications is 23:55 on the day mentioned in the above field “Application deadline”. We advise you to allow enough time to complete and submit your full application, since only applications completed and submitted before the deadline will be considered. Please be aware that the deadline for submitting applications is considered to be the time zone for the country where the vacancy has arisen. Interviews will be held remotely (TEAMS). At Academic Work, your CV matters little; it’s your persuasive power and ambition that count. Come prove what you’re capable of: take on the challenge and pass the test! Account Manager for Academic Work Geneva! About the role Don't leave fit to chance! At Academic Work, we are experts in recruiting early-career professionals, with a clear ambition: to become THE leader in performance prediction. You establish the profiles of sought candidates and lead pricing negotiations. Your goal is to convince your interlocutors of the value of our support to build long-term collaborations. Market expertise and internal synergy: Drawing on your field knowledge, you provide insightful advice to your clients. Once the need is identified, you work closely with our recruiters. Rigor and results: You are responsible for your performance. To ensure consistent results, you apply our working methods precisely, from first contact to closing the deal. A sense of autonomy: You appreciate the freedom to organise your days and demonstrate great personal discipline to achieve your goals. Fluent French and advanced English level (C1). Driving licence (category B). What we offer you A high-performers ecosystem: A demanding and stimulating environment where we lift each other up and celebrate successes together (trips, kick-offs). Impact as a true driver: You will have a direct impact on your clients’ business and the trajectory of young talents. Think big & make it happen: A progressive fixed salary and a completely uncapped commission system. Here, your ambition is the only limit. The AW Sales Academy: An elite programme (2 weeks onboarding + ongoing coaching) to transform your potential into B2B expertise. Strategic autonomy: Great freedom to manage your schedule and steer your client portfolio. Our predictive recruitment process We use science to validate your potential: Alva Labs tests (logic & personality): Your passport to the next step. jobs.description: Chargé(e) de projets / Planificateur(trice) Sanitaire Notre bureau Conti & Associés Ingénieurs SA est un bureau d’ingénieurs spécialisé dans les techniques du bâtiment CVSER , implanté à Versoix (Genève) et Perroy (Vaud) . Actifs depuis 1983, nous regroupons aujourd’hui plus de 35 collaborateurs et intervenons dans les domaines suivants : • Chauffage, ventilation et climatisation (CVC) • Sanitaire • Électricité • Régulation / MCR et automatisme du bâtiment Nous accompagnons nos clients sur l’ensemble des phases SIA 108 , avec une activité importante sur les phases 3, 4 et 5 : études, appels d’offres, réalisation et réception des ouvrages. Nous intervenons également en phase 6 pour le suivi de l’exploitation et l’optimisation énergétique des bâtiments. Notre activité couvre aussi les audits et diagnostics énergétiques, la physique du bâtiment, les études de faisabilité CVSER, les CECB+, les missions GED et AMOén dans le cadre du programme éco21, ainsi que les expertises techniques CVSER pour des assurances, maîtres d’ouvrage ou dans le cadre de procédures judiciaires. Le poste Dans le cadre du développement de notre département Sanitaire, nous recherchons un(e) Chargé(e) de projets / Planificateur(trice) Sanitaire capable de participer à la conception et au suivi de projets variés, de l'étude jusqu'à la réalisation. Vos missions 1/ Études et conception a/ Concevoir et dimensionner les installations sanitaires conformément aux normes, directives et règles de l’art applicables en Suisse. b/ Réaliser les études des réseaux d’eau froide, eau chaude sanitaire, bouclage, eaux usées et eaux pluviales. c/ Réaliser les calculs et dimensionnements nécessaires aux projets. d/ Élaborer les plans, schémas de principe et détails techniques. 2/ Plans et soumissions a/ Réaliser et mettre à jour les plans sanitaires sous AutoCAD 2D . b/ Établir les quantitatifs et métrés nécessaires aux appels d’offres. c/ Participer à l’élaboration des soumissions CAN à l’aide des outils spécifiques tels que Plancal Nova / SNAP . d/ Participer à l’analyse technique des offres des entreprises. 3/ Coordination et réalisation a/ Assurer la coordination technique avec les disciplines chauffage, ventilation, électricité et régulation. b/ Participer aux séances avec les maîtres d’ouvrage, architectes, entreprises et autres mandataires. c/ Participer au suivi de l’exécution des installations sur le terrain. d/ Contrôler la conformité des installations avec les plans, normes et prescriptions du projet. e/ Participer aux réceptions des installations et au suivi des réserves. Vos qualités Nous recherchons avant tout une personne : • autonome dans les missions correspondant à son niveau d'expérience ; • pragmatique et à l’aise avec la réalité du terrain • capable de prendre des initiatives et des responsabilités • appréciant le travail en équipe et les échanges entre disciplines • ayant envie de progresser et de s’investir durablement dans notre bureau. Selon votre expérience et votre degré d’autonomie, le poste pourra évoluer vers davantage de responsabilités et la gestion complète de projets sanitaires. Merci de nous transmettre votre CV accompagné de quelques lignes de présentation.

jobs.title: Senior Event Planning Manager
jobs.description: People at 1800 metres above sea level shape luxury mountain travel. Our dynamic and international team offers our guests smart luxury for an unparalleled holiday experience. As a team member of the luxurious Kulm Group, you are part of the key to our success. Together we make every stay inspiring, unique and distinctive. And as such, we live our culture: discreet luxury, inspiration and life experience. Together we make this possible. This is your chance to become part of our defining culture: What you will achieve with us Elegant gala dinners, exclusive weddings, high-profile business events and bespoke celebrations – across two of Switzerland’s most renowned establishments. As Event Planning Manager , you accompany the entire planning process from enquiry to operational handover and ensure that every event is precisely planned, efficiently coordinated and flawlessly executed at both the Kulm Hotel St. Moritz and the Grand Hotel Kronenhof Pontresina. Your responsibilities: Operational detailed planning & implementation: Seamless takeover of confirmed bookings from Sales; detailed coordination of all processes including room concepts, F&B procedures, technology and individual guest requests. Hub within the house: Precise creation and timely distribution of Function Sheets (BEOs) as well as daily close coordination with Banqueting, Kitchen, Service, Technical Services and Front Office of both establishments. jobs.description: For Ullrich Hospitality AG, we are looking for a part-time cook in the production kitchen (m/f/d) on an hourly wage by arrangement. Become part of a dynamic team that inspires Basel and the whole of Switzerland with innovative concepts in gastronomy, fiduciary services, and business consulting! The Ullrich Enterprise Group combines gastronomy, fiduciary services, and consulting. Our group comprises the following three business areas: Ullrich Konzepte supports companies in business development and strategic alignment. With comprehensive know-how in business development and gastronomy conception, it offers customised solutions. Ullrich Treuhand provides fiduciary services for various mandates from different industries, ranging from financial accounting and controlling to human resources. Ullrich Hospitality , based in Arlesheim, is one of the leading event and catering companies in Switzerland. We organise large-scale events across Switzerland with up to 6,500 people and operate several event locations, an event hall, and seminar rooms. Our young team stands for a hands-on mentality, innovative concepts, and experiential character – far beyond classic gastronomy. We create culinary, organisational, and emotional moments that remain memorable. We employ around 70 staff and place great importance on ensuring that not only our customers and partners but also our employees have a unique and positive experience with us. Flexible working – as it suits you. Throughout the year, we regularly have many events and are constantly looking for support in the team. Whether as a weekly part-time helper, temporarily for several weeks, or as a seasonal job in summer or before Christmas – with us, you can be flexible. Ideal alongside your studies or as a part-time job to earn some extra money. We adapt to your daily routine! Your tasks Production – Preparation of cold and hot dishes for our outlets, catering, and events Hygiene – Maintaining cleanliness and order in the kitchen, adhering to hygiene regulations Logistics – Packing and labelling prepared dishes for our outlets, catering, and events Flexible – Assisting with catering and events as needed Requirements Training – Completed training as a cook with a federal certificate of competence (EFZ) Flexible – You are flexible in various departments and have initial experience in catering and events Communication – You have business fluent German skills Teamwork – You enjoy working in a team and integrate well into existing structures Working style – You are proactive, flexible, and keep an overview even in hectic situations Benefits Ullrich Hospitality AG is located on a modern industrial estate directly adjacent to the Birs recreational area. After work, you can relax by the water or take a short walk. Free staff parking and good public transport connections are available. With us, you can take responsibility and contribute to achieving goals. We offer a dynamic team with an open corporate culture characterised by loyalty and collegiality, which is strengthened by monthly team events. Unlike many gastronomy businesses, we do not have curfews, and in summer as well as at Christmas and New Year, we have two-week company holidays.
